notes.title: Development Update | Roadmap To V 1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/9e4f1479de7513823cd4a7299a38d7010bdd35d4.png[/img]

[h2]Exciting Update for Retro Arcade Enthusiasts![/h2]

[h3]After carefully reviewing the feedback from the recent festival Demos and considering what's best for players, I've made a thrilling decision: I’m gearing up to launch Version 1.0 of the game. I'm skipping the Early Access phase to deliver the complete, polished experience you deserve from day one!
[/h3]

The Early Access banner has been removed and some updates have been made to the store page to celebrate this update and show a more current state of the project.

As always if you wanted to get your hands on the game and access it early you can still do that through the Demo which will be updated 2-3 more times before release, the last update will reflect the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40663625/88df0973f8d637959fadb303aac57e2475eab39f.png[/img]

Demo Version 3 is on its way, completely dedicated to implementing your feedback and adding more features. Here’s what I’m working on behind the scenes for the upcoming Demo 3:

[list]
[*] squashing bugs left and right to ensure a seamless experience
[*] fine tuning gameplay balance for maximum fun and less difficulty
[*] integrating your feedback across interface and gameplay 
[*] completing more features to enhance your experience
[*] performance is getting optimized for smoother uninterrupted gameplay
[*] interface updates for more accessibility and choice of preferences
[*] ramping up content production and polishing the existing content
[*] localization and compatibility testing to ensure everyone can enjoy the game
[/list]
From alpha to beta to release and beyond, I’m working on crafting an experience that's not just fun but a true reflection of the nostalgia of retro arcades racing delivered in a modern fashion. I started refining in late 2023, now in 2024 the playable Demo is in your hands and in 2025, you'll finally be able to dive headfirst into the full retro arcade experience!

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content:
06/25/2024 

- made varying speeds on left and right lane
- reduced oncoming opposing traffic speed
- made it easier to recharge nitro
- hud opacity increased
- removed interface distortion
- rolling intro framerate doubled
- some small geometry optimizations
- replaced widescreen finishline display with jumbotron
- reduced size of fueltruck hitboxes easier for full refueling

06/26/2024 

- runtime optimizations
- transcoded video files for better compatibility
- master volume ceiling reduced
